method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (the text's no where it says no; 'does not reach it' and NOTHING, with a NOTHING-kind tag, where it does not answer); the dates in one module, the rules and exported questions in another, the cases in a third; one regulative rule (AHRC Act s 46PO(2)) run by EVALTRACE inside an exported question that takes only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Racial Discrimination Act 1975 (Cth), Compilation No. 19, compilation date 13 December 2022 (register id C2022C00366), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A00274.txt; with the Australian Human Rights Commission Act 1986, Compilation No. 58, compilation date 18 September 2026 (register id C2026C00416), ss 3(1), 46P, 46PB, 46PE, 46PF(1)(b), 46PH, 46PO, 46POA(1), 46POB(3), 46PSA only, as deposited at subjects/au/australian-human-rights-commission-act-1986/registers/source-bundle/C2004A03366.txt; with the Federal Court of Australia Act 1976, Compilation No. 59, compilation date 11 December 2024, Part IVA ss 33C(1), 33E, 33J, 33ZB, 33ZE only, as deposited at subjects/au/federal-court-of-australia-act-1976/registers/source-bundle/C2004A01586.txt; the Acts Interpretation Act 1901, Compilation No. 39, compilation date 28 March 2026, ss 2G(2), 36 only, as deposited at subjects/au/acts-interpretation-act-1901/registers/source-bundle/C1901A00002.txt; and the Crimes Act 1914, Compilation No. 167, compilation date 27 August 2026, s 4AA(1) only, as deposited at subjects/au/crimes-act-1914/registers/source-bundle/C1914A00012.txt

seat: the person discriminated against: the individual to whom the Act is applied and who may claim under it -- the worker or job seeker, the member of a community or group treated differently by a public body, a law or a business because of race, colour, descent or national or ethnic origin, the person victimised for complaining, and the group member in a representative complaint or application (rda-claims.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run rda-dates.l4 ; l4 run rda-claims.l4 ; l4 run rda-cases.l4
checks.result: 191 assertions written, 191 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: Claims under the Act, with focus on a group claim over policing and public services (including class actions) and on employment. In: RDA s 3(1), (3), (4), s 5, s 6(1), (2), s 6A(2), Part II whole (ss 8-18AA), Part IIA whole (ss 18B-18E), ss 26, 27(2); AHRC Act ss 3(1), 46P(1), (1A), (2), (3), 46PB, 46PE, 46PF(1)(b), 46PH(1)(b) and its grounds, 46PO(1)-(5), 46POA(1), 46POB(3), 46PSA; Federal Court of Australia Act 1976 Part IVA ss 33C(1), 33E, 33J, 33ZB, 33ZE; Acts Interpretation Act 1901 ss 2G(2), 36; Crimes Act 1914 s 4AA(1). Out: RDA ss 1, 2, 4, 6A(1), (3), 6B, 7, 18F, Part III, ss 27(1), (1A), 27F, Part VI, ss 44-47, the Schedule (asked as facts); AHRC Act s 46P(1B) and the inquiry, conciliation, amendment, withdrawal, injunction, representation and assistance provisions; the rest of Part IVA (procedure the group member does not decide). Reasons in NOTES.md.
